import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, m, r, c, d;
    static int[] occ = new int[100];
    static Pair[] p = new Pair[100];

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;
        Pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static class Edge {
        int to, next, val, cost;
        Edge(int to, int next, int val, int cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.next = next;
            this.val = val;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostMaxFlow {
        static final int N = 10000;
        static final int M = 20000000;
        static int[] head = new int[N];
        static int cnt;
        static int[] dis = new int[N];
        static int[] fr = new int[N];
        static int[] id = new int[N];
        static int S, T, total_cost;
        static Edge[] edges = new Edge[M];

        static Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        static boolean[] in_queue = new boolean[N];

        static void add_edge(int u, int v, int w, int c) {
            edges[cnt] = new Edge(v, head[u], w, c);
            head[u] = cnt++;
            edges[cnt] = new Edge(u, head[v], 0, -c);
            head[v] = cnt++;
        }

        static boolean spfa() {
            Arrays.fill(dis, 0x3f3f3f3f);
            dis[S] = 0;
            q.clear();
            q.add(S);
            Arrays.fill(in_queue, false);
            in_queue[S] = true;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int x = q.poll();
                in_queue[x] = false;
                for (int i = head[x]; i != -1; i = edges[i].next) {
                    if (edges[i].val == 0) continue;
                    if (dis[edges[i].to] > dis[x] + edges[i].cost) {
                        dis[edges[i].to] = dis[x] + edges[i].cost;
                        fr[edges[i].to] = x;
                        id[edges[i].to] = i;
                        if (!in_queue[edges[i].to]) {
                            in_queue[edges[i].to] = true;
                            q.add(edges[i].to);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dis[T] == 0x3f3f3f3f) return false;
            int x = T, min_flow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            while (x != S) {
                min_flow = Math.min(min_flow, edges[id[x]].val);
                x = fr[x];
            }
            total_cost += dis[T] * min_flow;
            x = T;
            while (x != S) {
                edges[id[x]].val -= min_flow;
                edges[id[x] ^ 1].val += min_flow;
                x = fr[x];
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        r = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        Arrays.fill(MinCostMaxFlow.head, -1);
        MinCostMaxFlow.cnt = 0;
        MinCostMaxFlow.total_cost = 0;

        int R = r + n + 1;
        int S = R * n + 1;
        int T = R * n + 2;
        MinCostMaxFlow.S = S;
        MinCostMaxFlow.T = T;

        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            occ[i] = 0;
        }
        p = new Pair[100];
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            p[i] = new Pair(0, 0);
        }

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 1; i <= r; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            occ[x]++;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int first = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int second = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            p[i] = new Pair(first, second);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < r + n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= r; k++) {
                    int from1 = i * n + p[j].first;
                    int to1 = (i + 1) * n + p[j].second;
                    MinCostMaxFlow.add_edge(from1, to1, 1, (2 * k - 1) * d);

                    int from2 = i * n + p[j].second;
                    int to2 = (i + 1) * n + p[j].first;
                    MinCostMaxFlow.add_edge(from2, to2, 1, (2 * k - 1) * d);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= r + n; i++) {
            int from = i * n + 1;
            MinCostMaxFlow.add_edge(from, T, Integer.MAX_VALUE, i * c);
            for (int j = 2; j <= n; j++) {
                int from2 = (i - 1) * n + j;
                int to2 = i * n + j;
                MinCostMaxFlow.add_edge(from2, to2, Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            MinCostMaxFlow.add_edge(S, i, occ[i], 0);
        }

        while (MinCostMaxFlow.spfa());

        System.out.println(MinCostMaxFlow.total_cost);
    }
}
